difficulty_reason: Prove Picardfunctor_{X/B} -> B is smooth for relative dimension <= 1: the Picard stack is smooth (lemma-pic-curves-smooth) and the gerbe Picardstack -> Picardfunctor is surjective and smooth (lemma-pic-gerbe-over-pic-functor with the gerbe-smooth lemma); composing a smooth surjective presentation U -> Picardstack with the gerbe gives U -> Picardfunctor surjective smooth with U -> B surjective smooth (composition preserves both properties), and smoothness of the functor descends along the smooth surjective cover by the syntomic-smooth-etale-permanence lemma.
